instruction: Help me enable loop/repeat all mode in VLC so videos play continuously

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to enable VLC loop mode by setting 'loop=1' in vlcrc. The evaluator reads the configuration file and verifies loop mode is enabled (value 1). Default value is 0 (disabled), so user must change it to 1 to enable continuous playback.

Metric correctly parses vlcrc file to extract loop setting value
Expected value '1' is semantically correct for enabling VLC loop/repeat all mode
